Ce guide vous explique étape par étape c: This guide explains step by step how the partner program works. From referring a client to receiving your commission.
Vous identifiez une personne ou une entr: You identify a person or company that needs a website, application, or digital service. No need to be an expert: you just need to know someone with a project.

Remplissez le formulaire de soumission a: Fill in the submission form with the client's information. It's fast, simple, and confidential.
Un accord de confidentialité (NDA) est a: A non-disclosure agreement (NDA) is automatically put in place to protect all parties. You are covered from the moment of submission.
Notre équipe contacte le client, analyse: Our team contacts the client, analyzes their needs, and sends them a quote. When the client accepts, the project starts automatically.
Nous développons le projet. Vous pouvez: We develop the project. You can track progress in real time from your partner dashboard.
Votre commission est calculée automatiqu: Your commission is calculated automatically. For a €5,000 project (excl. VAT), you receive €{{amount}} ({{rate}}% commission).
Voici comment votre commission est calcu: Here's how your commission is calculated with a concrete example:
Ce calcul se fait automatiquement. Vous: This calculation is done automatically. You don't have to calculate anything yourself.

Vous êtes payé une fois que le client a: You get paid once the client has settled their invoice. As soon as payment is confirmed, your commission is calculated and added to your balance. Payments are made monthly.
Que se passe-t-il si le client refuse le: What happens if the client declines the quote?
Si le client refuse le devis, aucune com: If the client declines the quote, no commission is due. You can always submit this client again if their needs change.
Est-ce que je peux soumettre un client q: Can I submit a client I've already submitted?
Oui, si le client a un nouveau projet ou: Yes, if the client has a new project or their situation has changed. Each submission is handled independently.
Un NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) est un: An NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) is a confidentiality agreement. It protects information exchanged between all parties: you, the client, and NA Innovations.
Est-ce que le client sait que je l'ai re: Does the client know I referred them?
Par défaut, nous ne divulguons pas votre: By default, we do not disclose your identity to the client. However, you can choose to be mentioned if you wish.

Votre commission est calculée sur le mon: Your commission is calculated on the project's amount excluding VAT. VAT is not included in the calculation. For example, for an invoice of €6,050 incl. VAT (21% VAT), the calculation base is €5,000 excl. VAT.
